title: 7 Factors 2 Discernment
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk teaches that cultivating awareness through mindfulness is essential for developing discernment, which involves understanding the causes and effects of our actions and experiences. This awareness allows us to make subtle choices about where to put our energy in order to cultivate wholesome actions, rather than getting stuck in analysis or judgment. By combining mindfulness with discernment, we can develop a deeper understanding of the present moment and its causes, leading to greater awakening and liberation from suffering.
